target_customer: Middle and high school students and the schools and teachers who assign math courses; consumer app planned
problem: Students need personalized math help aligned to school curriculum. Tegore pairs an AI tutor with curriculum-based lesson plans, voice and interactive visuals.
business_model: School partnerships plus a planned consumer subscription product (Duolingo for Math); pricing not found

founders.name: Ende Shen
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education; sole listed founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: A voice and visual tutor with dialectic teaching built on language models is standard engineering with hard parts in pedagogy and accuracy.

defensibility.rationale: School relationships and curriculum content could create some lock-in, but general models and larger tutors like Khanmigo are easy substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; incumbents kept shipping AI tutors through 2026 per comparison articles.

market_need_then: The company reports a Spring 2025 pilot in San Mateo County where 85 percent of students mastered polynomial division in one 20 minute session; this is one vendor-reported pilot and not independently verified.

identity.mascot_or_character: Noor, the AI tutor, described as a tutor who never gives up
identity.voice_and_tone: warm and encouraging, safety and privacy emphasized

brand_strength.rationale: A named tutor character gives some identity, but no press or community evidence about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Tegore is an active one person company from Spring 2025 building an AI math tutor aligned to K-12 curriculum with school pilots. No outcome event or verified funding was found. Strong incumbents exist in AI tutoring, so the outlook is unproven and no factors are assigned.
notes: Caplight lists 500K USD total funding with last round Accelerator on 2025-04-01 from an aggregator; no primary confirmation, and it likely reflects the YC deal, so not recorded as a round. No dated competitor sources near April 2025 were found; the comparison articles are 2026, so the list is empty. Pilot result is a vendor claim.
